title: Reimporting a GLTF scene added to an exported `Array` removes it from that `Array`
body:
### Tested versions

- Reproducible in v4.5.1-stable, v4.6.1-stable, master (a3e84cc2a)

### System information

Godot v4.7.dev.mono (a3e84cc2a) - macOS Tahoe (26.2.0) - Multi-window, 1 monitor - Metal (Mobile) - integrated Apple M3 Pro (Apple9) - Apple M3 Pro (11 threads) - 18.00 GiB memory

### Issue description

Possibly related to:
- https://github.com/godotengine/godot/issues/75970
- https://www.reddit.com/r/godot/comments/gv9k50/inherited_scene_doesnt_update_when_model/

As the title says: reimporting a GLTF scene added to an exported `Array` removes the reference to that GLTF scene node from that `Array` if the scene is currently open. (Look below for video recording...)

Occasionally this also causes a full crash - I have not figured out what steps exactly I need to take to make it crash, but I do have some logs from one time it happened (I tried to select the `FooInherited` node and then it crashed):

### Steps to reproduce

1. Open `foo_inherited.tscn` (it **MUST** be opened while re-importing)
2. Reimport `model.glb`
3. Select `FooInherited`
